integrity: The two independent exact-arithmetic checkers and mathematical derivation are included. All claimed finite computations were replayed. The argument for geometric parameters depends on a symbolic polynomial identity and semilinear rank cycles, rather than extrapolation from finite-point tests.
scientific_limitations: The all-geometric-parameter statement covers a !=0,1 over the algebraic closure in characteristic seven; the zeta table covers exactly five coefficient parameters in F7, not distinct curve isomorphism classes, and no universal genus-five or generalized-Howe classification is asserted. Independent priority and mathematical reviews not performed.
title: Arithmetic stratification of a genus-five Howe pencil over characteristic seven
